newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Bertinotti no statement after budget talks.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Bertinotti no statement after budget talks.

text.p: The leader of the hardleft Communist Refoundation, Fausto Bertinotti, left a meeting with Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi on Tuesday but did not make any statements.
Bertinotti spent around an hour in the prime minister's office and had been scheduled to talk to Prodi and deputy-prime minister Walter Veltroni about the forthcoming mini-budget.
A Refoundation spokesman said it did not expect Bertinotti to make any official statement.
Refoundation, which secures the government's majority in the lower house of parliament, has said it cannot back any further tax hikes or spending cuts. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
